description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Macro f-score across different Frequency categories for two distinct methods. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled "Frequency," and displays three groups ordered from left to right: a category with an obscured label covered by a solid grey rectangle, "Medium," and "Low." The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Macro f-score," using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 1 with numeric tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 0.1. The chart features grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a pair of side-by-side bars. According to the legend positioned below the horizontal axis, the light peach bars represent "RECA" and the solid orange bars represent "GAIT_GAT." Each bar is explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value near the top, and the bars feature a slight drop shadow effect. In the first category with the obscured label, the RECA bar has a value of 0.837, and the GAIT_GAT bar is the tallest in the chart at 0.877. In the "Medium" category, the RECA bar is 0.538 and the GAIT_GAT bar is 0.609. In the "Low" category, the RECA bar is the shortest in the chart at 0.114, while the GAIT_GAT bar is 0.224. Overall, the groups of bars are arranged in descending order of their annotated values from left to right.
